# Claude Code 2.1.280 — status line e terminal

Resumo verificado em 2026-09-22 contra os docs oficiais; detalhes nas fontes.

- statusLine key (settings.json, Scope Any file): {"type":"command","command":"...","padding":N,"refreshInterval":N(min 1),"hideVimModeIndicator":bool}. No color/template fields; script does all formatting (ANSI + OSC 8). Custom status line renders in its own row above footer badges and suppresses most footer hints (esc to interrupt, ? for shortcuts, hold space to speak).
- Runs at session start/resume, on new assistant message, /compact end, permission-mode change, vim toggle, command-string change, refreshInterval tick, rate-limit resets_at, cache expires_at. 300ms debounce; in-flight script cancelled on new trigger; editing the SCRIPT FILE is NOT hot-reloaded (only a changed command string runs immediately). Read COLUMNS/LINES env, not tput. Runs locally, no tokens. Non-zero exit or empty stdout blanks the line; stderr ignored; claude --debug logs first invocation.
- Gates: off entirely if managed disableAllHooks or folder untrusted; narrowed to managed-only if allowManagedHooksOnly, disableAllHooks:true outside managed, or --safe-mode. With no managed statusLine these disable it silently. Same for subagentStatusLine and fileSuggestion.
- stdin JSON top-level: cwd, session_id, session_name, prompt_id, transcript_path, model{id,display_name}, workspace{current_dir,project_dir,added_dirs,git_worktree,repo{host,owner,name}}, version, output_style{name}, cost{total_cost_usd,total_duration_ms,total_api_duration_ms,total_lines_added,total_lines_removed}, context_window{total_input_tokens,total_output_tokens,context_window_size,used_percentage,remaining_percentage,current_usage{...}}, exceeds_200k_tokens, prompt_cache{...}, fast_mode, effort{level}, thinking{enabled}, rate_limits{five_hour,seven_day,spend_limit}, vim{mode}, agent{name}, pr{number,url,review_state,kind}, worktree{name,path,branch,original_cwd,original_branch}.
- May be absent: session_name, prompt_id, git_worktree, repo, effort, vim, agent, pr, worktree, rate_limits (Pro/Max or gateway; only after first API response; each window independently absent; window dropped after resets_at), prompt_cache. May be null: current_usage, used_percentage, remaining_percentage, prompt_cache.hit_ratio, expires_at, last_miss_at, last_miss_cause, recache_tokens_if_cold.
- rate_limits.five_hour/seven_day.used_percentage 0-100; spend_limit.used_percentage may exceed 100 (gateway only, v2.1.251+). used_percentage = input + cache_creation + cache_read tokens only. effort.level in low/medium/high/xhigh/max; ultracode reports xhigh.
- /statusline (natural language) writes a script in ~/.claude/ and updates settings; /statusline delete removes.
- subagentStatusLine: {"type":"command","command":...} only; stdin = base hook fields + columns + tasks[]{id,name,type,status,description,label,startTime,model,effort,contextWindowSize,tokenCount,tokenSamples,cwd}; model/contextWindowSize omitted until resolved (v2.1.205+); effort string or numeric budget, absent if inherited (v2.1.214+). Output one JSON line per row {"id":..,"content":..}.
- Hook common fields: permission_mode values "default","plan","acceptEdits","auto","dontAsk","bypassPermissions" (Manual = "default"; not on all events); effort only in tool-use-context events, also $CLAUDE_EFFORT; scratchpad_dir absent without scratchpad (v2.1.257+). Notification hook stdin adds message, optional title, notification_type; cannot block.
- Spinner/footer keys (Any file): spinnerVerbs{mode append|replace,verbs[]}, spinnerTipsEnabled, spinnerTipsOverride{tips,tipsFile,label,excludeDefault} (objects/tipsFile/label/excludeDefault only from user, --settings, managed; project/local = plain strings; multi-file: tips from all, other fields from highest precedence; tipsFile not via server-managed), showTurnDuration, timeFormat, timeZone (IANA), terminalProgressBarEnabled, prefersReducedMotion, preferredNotifChannel (auto|terminal_bell|iterm2|iterm2_with_bell|kitty|ghostty|notifications_disabled), footerLinksRegexes (User or managed).
- /config toggles -> keys: editorMode, theme, spinnerTipsEnabled, showTurnDuration, timeFormat, terminalProgressBarEnabled, prefersReducedMotion, preferredNotifChannel, promptSuggestionEnabled, verbose, awaySummaryEnabled, autoContinueAtUsageLimit, externalEditorContext (~/.claude.json), copyOnSelect (~/.claude.json only), autoScrollEnabled, enableWorkflows, language. /config key=value works in -p and via Remote Control.
- Task list Ctrl+T fills only on Claude 3.x, Opus 4-4.7, Sonnet 4-4.6, Haiku 4.5; on current models (Opus 5.5/Fable) set env CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1. env from project/local applies only after trust (or at -p startup) and cannot set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, HOME, TMPDIR, XDG_*, etc.; prefer user settings for env.
- Fullscreen: tui "fullscreen"|"default"; CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 forces on; new users (first use on/after 2026-05-06, or first launch v2.1.239+) default to fullscreen; startup dialog at most 3 launches; after 2 failed starts stays classic (env var still honored, tui setting not); screen-reader mode ignores /tui fullscreen. In fullscreen, notifications get their own row instead of sharing the status line row.
- Newline: Ctrl+J or \ + Enter everywhere; VS Code needs /terminal-setup once for Shift+Enter (also sets terminal.integrated.gpuAcceleration off). Vim: editorMode "vim", vimInsertModeRemaps {"jj":"<Esc>"} (User or managed, 1-second window), hideVimModeIndicator when rendering vim.mode yourself.
- keybindings.json: ~/.claude/keybindings.json, hot-reloaded; bindings[{context,bindings{key:action|null}}]; chords space-separated; reserved Ctrl+C/D/M/[/I/H. Voice: voice{enabled,mode hold|tap,autoSubmit}; rebind via voice:pushToTalk in Chat context ("space": null optional); language key (e.g. "portuguese") drives responses, dictation (pt) and auto session titles (session_name).
- Babel-os plan: python3 statusline at /Users/marcelomaximos/Desktop/babel-os/.claude/statusline.py, absolute path in command, refreshInterval 10, writes throttled heartbeat to memoria/batimentos.jsonl keyed by session_id; must guard null/absent fields and never exit non-zero. Do not set disableAllHooks; do not run --safe-mode if status line is wanted.
